# Let's parse the file names to understand the mapping.
import re

files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/documents/work/meetings_data/')
for entry in files:
    if entry.endswith('/'):
        continue  # skip directories
    # Extract filename from full path
    filename = entry.split('/')[-1]
    # Split on '__'
    if '__' in filename:
        date_part, rest = filename.split('__', 1)
        # Split rest on last '.' to get base and extension
        if '.' in rest:
            base, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
        else:
            base = rest
            ext = ''
        print(f"File: {filename} -> date={date_part}, base={base}, ext={ext}")

bases = set()
for entry in files:
    if entry.endswith('/'):
        continue
    filename = entry.split('/')[-1]
    if '__' in filename:
        date_part, rest = filename.split('__', 1)
        if '.' in rest:
            base, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
        else:
            base = rest
            ext = ''
        bases.add(base)

print("Unique bases:", bases)
for base in bases:
    dir_path = f"~/documents/work/meetings_data/{base}/"
    # Check if directory exists
    exists = apis.file_system.directory_exists(access_token=access_token, directory_path=dir_path)
